caption: The drawing consists of three distinct black-and-white objects on a plain light background. On the left, there is a circular object resembling a medallion or locket, featuring an ornate border and intricate floral or leaf patterns encircling a central monogram with the letter "A," all surrounded by decorative designs. Above this circular object, there is a rectangular area with musical staff lines. In the center of the drawing, a vertically oriented elongated object is present, resembling a handle or a ceremonial staff, with musical staff lines and notes depicted across its width, and the letters "M" and "A" are visible among the notes. The bottom of this object features a small circular section with a detailed human face or mask, oriented forward. On the right side of the image, there is an elaborate heraldic crest, with a shield at the center displaying a chevron and three shapes within it, flanked by ornate foliated mantling, and topped by a helmet and a lion as a crest. The entire composition is rendered in fine lines with no shading or color, and the artist's signature "Lawrence Flynn" appears in cursive at the bottom right.
title: Silver Tankard
